Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Cultural Activities Suggested vocabulary to be signed: wedding, dance, party, ma
Topic 13.2: Sign Reading 13.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 13.2.1 Fluency, part of Cultural Activities Suggested vocabulary to be signed: wedding, dance, party, ma in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why should we read fluently?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 13.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration - Teamwork as the learner takes part in group work, reading activities and games.

Values:
Responsibility: Hardwork as learner plays reading games

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Effective communication as learners learn to sign read fluently.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate sign reading skills to other learning areas that require the learners to sign read a variety of texts fluently.

Suggested Learning Resources
